steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I feel like I'm a kid in a classroom, having a science lesson for the first time. It's no hyperbole at all to say that 'science is the future of Columbia.'

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I regret not being able to stay longer and hear about your other projects.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You are always welcome at Rhine Lab, Mr. Jackson.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Thank you, Director Jara. I hope my visit didn't cause too much inconvenience.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Kind of you to say so. It was a pleasure to be your tour guide today.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Having the famous Marianne Blake as a tour guide alone makes this trip to Trimounts worthwhile.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Between the two of us, I'm a pretty big fan of yours.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I have an autographed poster of your debut film on the office wall.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: A present from my wife when I was elected.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Kindly make a note to follow up with the special district government about Rhine Lab's application for a new research facility.

steps.name: Vice President's Secretary
steps.text: Will do, sir.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I guess that will be it for today, Miss Jara.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I wish you a pleasant stay at Trimounts.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: May the sun shine on the next day, as it has today.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Come on, mash that photo button!

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Mr. Vice President! What did you think about your trip to Rhine today?

steps.name: Rhine Staff
steps.text: Ask your questions in order, please! We have ten minutes, there's no rush.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You heard me right. I'm clapping.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: 'Vice President's Visit Bolsters Rhine Lab’s Claim as Industry Leader'... the headlines write themselves.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The tour concluded without incident. The Vice President will leave Rhine Lab in ten minutes.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I got the map you sent, Doctor.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So there's a secret passage that leads right to the underground structure, but it's not in the plans that Muelsyse gave you?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Leave it to me!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I've been sitting here twiddling my thumbs while you and Rosmontis have fun with the power armor up there. Didn't even see a shadow.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria is coming for me?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Then I have to go to the underground structure too. The Vice President is leaving in a few minutes, right? We can't take any risks.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: (Whisper) Ifrit moving out, Doctor.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: How are things up there?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Not sure. I didn't quite make it up to the surface, but there was no commotion.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: I'm guessing the attack failed.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: What about us?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: We activated the jammers and aren't supporting any other units... I don't think anyone is coming here. Ferdinand's route was very well-concealed.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Let's carry out the plan. It's almost time.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: The explosives?

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Set up while you were scouting... two tubes of advanced plastic explosives, enough to breach the containment structure.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: You know, I thought Ferdinand wanted to come back to Rhine Lab. But this is the liquified Originium pipeline used by his Energy Section.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: The Colonel says he's stuck in the same boat as us. He has no choice.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Don't really see the point of blowing this up now, though...

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: The Vice President should have left Rhine Lab by now. What good will blowing up the Originium pipes in the underground structure do?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: The Colonel has his plans. All we need to do is follow orders.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Who goes there?

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: A... kid?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Looks like the Doctor's intel was good.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, you, I don't know why you're hiding here, but I think you oughta surrender now.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: We lost contact with all units?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir. Sudden comms failure.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: The Vice President and his retinue, the press... no sign that anything is amiss. Looks like our guys were neutralized before they could move.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Reports indicate that our operations within Rhine are also being disrupted by the sudden appearance of some power armor.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We're also losing signal from the cameras on the streets.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We're losing control of the scene, sir.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: So, our best laid plans are like a sieve to the intelligence network of the Maylander Foundation.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: It's not surprising that they're able to respond, given how hastily this assassination plan was hatched.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Should we pull out, sir?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: They're bound to trace the trail back here, sooner or later.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: No hurry...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Mr. Vice President said he would like to 'have a nice chat with top researchers.' I intend to oblige him.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Situation at C1 and C2?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Still in position. Signal stable.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Activate the remote control on the top-right of the panel, Riker.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.
The remote control Blake referred to is a mundane mechanical button, fitted with an old-fashioned safety lock.
The soldier enters the password, and the cover pops open, revealing the red button.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: What is this, sir?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Remote control for the explosives that will blow up the containment around the liquified Originium pipes.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Look at the screen. According to the routes that Ferdinand provided, the Energy Section has several liquified Originium pipelines running through the west wing of Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Rhine Lab Engineering does a thorough job.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: In addition to standard safety measures, there are also underground containment structures that prevent chain reactions in the event of a leak.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The original plan was to cause a leak with an explosion, creating a chance for operatives on the ground to approach Jackson.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: By chance, however, Jackson's convoy will cross over one of these pipelines on the way back.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: You're Rhine Lab staff?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: I heard the Defense Section has a lot of bad-tempered people, but I'm surprised they would hire a kid so young.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I told you to surrender. I didn't say you could talk.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll try to short stop of turning you to ashes. The Doctor and Saria may want to question you, after all.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Wait, is that a flamethrower?

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Stop! There are liquified Originium pipes all around us!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So that's what's going on...
The flaming-red Savra girl makes her decision in a split second. She re-engages the flamethrower's safety lock, and swings it hard at the one on the left.
Then she charges towards the one on the right, and catches the side of his face with her fist.
In the time it takes for a flame to flicker, Ifrit is back on her two feet again, dusting off her palms.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Grgh...

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: I think my nose is broken...

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Run, kid...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Damn, he started the countdown...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Less than one minute left—

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Can C1 and C2 make it back?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Their contributions will be remembered, as well all others who give their lives this day.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: But Colonel... it's an entire convoy. Five cars, a dozen people in the retinue, possibly even Rhine staff members and reporters, and other passersby...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You have your orders, Riker.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: But I...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I'll hit the switch myself. That's my job. Your job is to report as soon as you get a signal from C1 and C2.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I won't defend myself if I stand trial for this someday.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: So I'm not going to waste my time explaining myself to my soldiers now.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We have the signal!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: The Vice President's convoy is reaching the target area on the west side of Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Colonel?
Blake places his hand on the cold mechanical button. A chill runs up his finger, and he pauses for a couple of seconds.
The soldier glances at his superior officer, whose brow is furrowed behind his sunglasses.
The soldier realizes that his commander is even more anxious than he is.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: (Whisper) Damn it all to hell!
Blake presses the button.
There is no sound, only an explosion on some of the screens.
On the tiny screen, the collapsing streets were like foam boards underneath bubbling flame. Then the screen goes black, the camera destroyed by flying debris.
There is no sound, but Blake and the soldier could hear the deafening boom in their heads.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: The surface should be close, but I can't see the path with all these stone slabs in the way...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, are you two okay?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh no, a chain explosion.
Ifrit?!
Ifrit hears a familiar voice through the echoes of the explosion and the falling rubble.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria? I'm here!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I hear you... hang in there!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I have a lock!
Ifrit can hear Saria's voice shaking. Something touches her fingertips in the darkness. Calcium crystals? Saria's Originium Arts.
Like a stream of water, the crystals fill the gaps in the rubble, then expand, releasing a sickening crack—
Saria has forced an opening in the collapsed structure.
A hand reaches down from above. Ifrit grabs it and feels it pull her up, while the calcium tunnel shatters behind her.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm fine, just a little dusty.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Your face... were you crying?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I-I wasn't crying! Just a little anxious, that's all.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Your hands are dusty too, Saria. You're making my face even dirtier.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Oh, sorry.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: And these two?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: They were the ones who planted the bomb that blew up the liquified Originium pipelines, so I brought them out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But I couldn't stop the explosion...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You did well.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You really did.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What is it, Ifrit?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: ...Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Why are you here?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Mr. Vice President, Mr. Pavard, it's safe to go now.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: The convoy?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Just a couple of mechs blown up. No need to worry.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: This car has been modified by the Engineering Section. It may not look much, but you can trust it.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I hope you brought your driver's license, Mr. Pavard. We'll take a special passage on the east side. We've planned a new route for you.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The rest of your retinue will return in small groups once the dust has settled.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Was the explosion expected?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: No, we wouldn't have allowed an explosion of this size to occur if we knew about it in advance.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But Rhine Lab and the Maylander Foundation's work isn't done until you're back safely at your residence... the enemy has more than one plan, and we have more than one contingency.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I just don't want to see 'Another Triton?' in the headlines tomorrow.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: There's no need to worry, we already have a plan in place for the press.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Once again, I wish you a pleasant stay in Trimounts.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Thank you.
